Assemble the comparison table and make the adequacy call

Source: R/callComparisons.R
callComparisons.Rd

Merges the layer metrics into one tidy table, one row per comparison, and assigns each comparison a call: Invalid (the contrast is not estimable, or too few samples per group), Caution (estimable but the condition is confounded with a covariate, or cell-count imbalance tracks the condition), Underpowered (valid but the sensitivity fraction is below target, or too few testable genes), or Adequate. Severity order is Invalid > Caution > Underpowered > Adequate; the reason column lists every flag so the single call never hides a second problem.

Usage

callComparisons(
  design,
  pseudobulk,
  variance,
  sensitivity,
  thresholds = defaultThresholds()
)

Arguments

design, pseudobulk, variance, sensitivity

The outputs of assessDesign(), assessPseudobulk(), estimateVariance() (its $summary) and estimateSensitivity().

thresholds

A list from defaultThresholds().

Value

A S4Vectors::DataFrame, one row per comparison, with all metrics, the call and a reason string.
